title: NorEval: A Norwegian Language Understanding and Generation Evaluation Benchmark
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to the religion category. The general finding for the NorTruthfulQA task, which includes religion, is that language models struggle with truthfulness. They tend to generate less truthful answers in the open-ended generation setup compared to the multiple-choice setup, highlighting challenges in evaluating open-ended QA in Norwegian.
references: Kenneth J Arrow. 2012. Social choice and individual values, volume 12. Yale university press.
